namingConventions: Prefer clear verbs for orchestration: cloneAll, buildAll, testAll, deployAll, statusAll, syncAll
Use AETHER metaphors where helpful: Mnesis(memory), Aletheia(truth), Inferaia(process), Reverie(imagination)
style.comments: Explain intent before mechanics. Keep comments concise but meaningful.

codingGuidelines.errorHandling: Always print actionable next steps; do not swallow errors.
codingGuidelines.extensibility: Design for easy addition of new repos via /config/workspace.json.
